mapper.insert: insert into safety_spot_check_process (flow_id, title, creator, create_time, status, check_emp, check_emp_no, duty_name, team_name, device_id, device_name, device_code, location, check_time, node_flag, need_reform, reform_user, reform_user_info, device_check_no, device_check_name, device_check_login) values (#{flowId}, #{title}, #{creator}, now(), '20', #{checkName}, #{checkEmpNo}, #{dutyName}, #{teamName}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceCode}, #{location}, #{checkTime}, #{nodeFlag}, #{needReform}, #{reformUser}, #{reformUserInfo}, #{deviceCheckNo}, #{deviceCheckName}, #{deviceCheckLogin})

insert into safety_spot_check_result (record_id, plan_time, finish_time, reform_finish, reform_img, reform_name, reform_time, reform_delay, delay_time, reform_leader, audit_note_msg) values
(#{recordId}, #{resultDTO.planTime}, #{resultDTO.finishTime}, #{resultDTO.reformFinish}, #{resultDTO.reformImg}, #{resultDTO.reformName}, #{resultDTO.reformTime}, #{resultDTO.reformDelay}, #{resultDTO.delayTime}, #{resultDTO.reformLeader}, #{resultDTO.auditNoteMsg})
mapper.select: select r.* from safety_spot_check_rule r left join safety_spot_rule_perm p on p.rule_id = r.id where p.spot_id = #{id} and r.delete_falg = '0' order by r.rule_sort asc

select * from safety_spot_link_record_rule lr where lr.device_id = #{id} and lr.record_id = (select max(id) from safety_spot_check_record r where r.device_id = #{id} and r.status <> 1) order by lr.rule_sort asc
select * from safety_spot_check_device_info t where t.id = #{deviceId}

select r.id from safety_spot_check_record r left join safety_spot_check_task t on t.id = r.task_id where r.device_id = #{deviceId} and r.status <> 1 and DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') between t.task_begin_date and t.task_end_date
select r.id from safety_spot_check_record r where r.flow_id = #{flowId}
select * from safety_spot_check_process p where p.flow_id = #{flowId}
select * from safety_spot_check_result t where t.record_id = #{recordId} order by t.id asc
select e.emp_no empNo, e.emp_name empName, e.email email,e.phone_no phoneNo from safety_employee_message e where e.status = 'NORMAL' and e.email like concat(#{username},'@','%')
select max(r.id) from safety_spot_check_record c left join safety_spot_check_result r on c.id = r.record_id and r.reform_finish=1 where c.flow_id = #{flowId} group by r.record_id
select d.factory_id from safety_spot_check_device_info d where d.id = #{deviceId}
